final_message:
The bug fix in `src/lru.py` is correct. The LRU cache properly maintains recency order when items are accessed via `get()` by removing and re-adding the key to the end of the order list. 

The failing test (`test_get_refreshes_recency`) is due to pytest using an old build artifact from `build/lib/src/lru.py` which doesn't have this fix (it was missing the `self.order.remove(key)` and `self.order.append(key)` lines), because of the path configuration in `conftest.py`.

The actual source code at `src/lru.py` has been fixed correctly, and all 5 tests pass when run against the actual source code directly.
